title: Básico
description: Conversas sobre o passado, planos e situações práticas de viagem e serviços.
goal: Você mantém conversas curtas sobre experiências, planos e necessidades do dia a dia.

units.title: Contando histórias
units.goal: Conversar sobre o que aconteceu, com amigos e colegas.

lessons.title: Conversa: o fim de semana
lessons.objective: Contar o que fez no fim de semana e reagir ao que o outro contou.
lessons.explanation:
Para contar algo no passado, use o passado simples. Para reagir com interesse:

- *Really? That sounds great!* — Sério? Parece ótimo!
- *Oh no! Are you OK?* — Ah não! Você está bem?
- *What was it like?* — Como foi?

key_phrases.en: What did you do last weekend?
key_phrases.pt: O que você fez no fim de semana passado?

exercises.prompt: What did you do last weekend?
exercises.context: Um colega pergunta sobre o seu fim de semana.
answers: I went to the beach with my family.
I visited my grandmother.
I watched a movie at home.

exercises.prompt: I went hiking and it started raining!
exercises.context: O colega contou uma experiência ruim.
answers: Oh no! Did you get wet?
That's too bad! Are you OK?
Really? What happened next?
exercises.explanation: Reações curtas mostram que você está ouvindo.

exercises.prompt: Did you enjoy it?
exercises.context: O colega quer saber se você gostou do que fez.
exercises.hint: Diga se gostou e por quê.
answers: Yes, it was really fun!
Yes, I loved it. It was relaxing.
Not really, it was too long.

exercises.prompt: Ouça e digite a frase.
answers: Really? That sounds amazing!

lessons.title: Conversa: um dia difícil
lessons.objective: Explicar um problema e pedir ou oferecer ajuda.
lessons.explanation:
Para explicar um problema: *I missed my bus.* / *I lost my keys.*

Para pedir ajuda: *Could you help me?* / *Can you give me a hand?*

Para oferecer ajuda: *Do you want me to help?* / *I can drive you.*

key_phrases.en: I missed the bus this morning.
key_phrases.pt: Perdi o ônibus hoje de manhã.

key_phrases.en: Can you give me a hand?

exercises.prompt: You look tired. What happened?
exercises.context: Um amigo percebe que você está cansado.
answers: I missed the bus this morning.
I didn't sleep well last night.
I had a really long day at work.

exercises.prompt: Oh no! Do you need anything?
answers: Could you help me with my bags?
Can you give me a hand, please?
Yes, could you lend me your phone?

exercises.prompt: Sure! I can drive you home.
answers: Thank you so much, that's kind of you!
That would be great, thanks!
Thanks! I really appreciate it.
exercises.explanation: *That would be great* aceita a oferta.

exercises.prompt: Qual frase oferece ajuda?
options: Do you want me to help you?
exercises.explanation: *Do you want me to help you?*

lessons.title: Conversa: conhecendo a rotina do outro
lessons.objective: Perguntar sobre hábitos e falar dos seus.
lessons.explanation:
Perguntas sobre hábitos usam o presente simples: *Do you usually cook at home?* / *How often do you exercise?*

Respostas de frequência: *always, usually, sometimes, never*.

key_phrases.pt: Com que frequência você se exercita?

exercises.prompt: Do you usually cook at home?
exercises.context: Um novo colega pergunta sobre seus hábitos.
exercises.hint: Responda com um advérbio de frequência.
answers: Yes, I usually cook at home.
Sometimes. I prefer eating out.
No, I never cook.
exercises.explanation: Advérbios de frequência vão antes do verbo principal.

exercises.prompt: How often do you exercise?
exercises.context: A pessoa quer saber sobre sua rotina de exercícios.
exercises.hint: Fale com que frequência faz exercício.
answers: I exercise three times a week.
I go to the gym every day.
Not very often, but I walk a lot.

exercises.prompt: What do you like to do in your free time?
exercises.hint: Fale de uma atividade que gosta.
answers: I like reading and watching movies.
I enjoy going to the park.
I like playing guitar.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: eu costumo acordar cedo nos fins de semana
answers: I usually wake up early on weekends.
exercises.explanation: O advérbio *usually* vem antes do verbo.

units.title: Planos e serviços
units.goal: Marcar encontros, resolver problemas em hotéis e fazer reservas.

lessons.title: Conversa: marcando um encontro
lessons.objective: Combinar dia, horário e local com alguém.
lessons.explanation:
Para combinar algo:

- *Are you free on Saturday?* — Você está livre no sábado?
- *How about 7 o'clock?* — Que tal às 7?
- *Let's meet at the café.* — Vamos nos encontrar no café.
- *See you then!* — Até lá!

exercises.prompt: Hey! Want to get together this week?
exercises.context: Um amigo quer marcar um encontro.
exercises.hint: Pergunte o dia que ele prefere.
answers: Sure! Are you free on Friday?
Sounds good. What day works for you?
Yes! How about Thursday evening?
exercises.explanation: *What day works for you?* é uma forma natural de combinar.

exercises.prompt: How about Friday at 8?
answers: Friday at 8 sounds great!
I'm busy at 8, how about 9?
Perfect, let's meet then.

exercises.prompt: Where should we meet?
answers: Let's meet at the café near the station.
How about the restaurant on Main Street?
I'll see you at the park.

exercises.prompt: Ouça e digite a frase.
exercises.text: See you then! Don't be late.
answers: See you then! Don't be late.
See you then, don't be late.

lessons.title: Conversa: no hotel
lessons.objective: Fazer check-in e pedir algo ao recepcionista.
lessons.explanation:
No hotel:

- *I have a reservation under Silva.* — Tenho uma reserva em nome de Silva.
- *Could I get a room with a view?* — Poderia ter um quarto com vista?
- *What time is breakfast?* — Que horas é o café da manhã?
- *Is there Wi-Fi in the room?* — Tem Wi-Fi no quarto?

key_phrases.en: I have a reservation under Silva.
key_phrases.pt: Tenho uma reserva em nome de Silva.
Que horas é o café da manhã?

exercises.prompt: Good afternoon! Do you have a reservation?
exercises.hint: Diga que tem reserva e o seu nome.
answers: Yes, I have a reservation under Silva.
Yes, the name is Silva.
I have a reservation for two nights.
exercises.explanation: *I have a reservation under...* é o padrão.

exercises.prompt: Here is your key. Room 204, second floor.
answers: Thank you! Where is the elevator?
Thanks. Where can I find the elevator?

exercises.prompt: Breakfast is served from 7 to 10.
exercises.context: Você quer saber mais sobre o café da manhã.
answers: Is breakfast included in the price?
Is breakfast included?
Thanks! Is breakfast included in the rate?

exercises.prompt: Como perguntar se o Wi-Fi funciona?
options: Is there Wi-Fi in the room?

lessons.title: Conversa: resolvendo um problema
lessons.objective: Reclamar de algo com educação e pedir solução.
lessons.explanation:
Para reclamar com educação:

- *Excuse me, there's a problem with my room.*
- *The air conditioning doesn't work.*
- *Could you send someone to fix it?*

Use *Sorry to bother you* antes de pedir algo.

key_phrases.en: There's a problem with my room.
key_phrases.pt: Há um problema no meu quarto.

key_phrases.en: Could you send someone to fix it?

exercises.prompt: Good morning! Is everything all right?
exercises.context: O recepcionista pergunta se está tudo bem.
exercises.hint: Diga que há um problema no quarto.
answers: Excuse me, there's a problem with my room.
Sorry to bother you, the air conditioning doesn't work.
exercises.explanation: *Excuse me* antes de reclamar soa educado.

exercises.prompt: I'm sorry to hear that. What's the problem?
answers: The shower is not working.
The air conditioning is too loud.
There's no hot water.
exercises.explanation: Descreva o problema de forma simples.

exercises.prompt: I'll send someone right away. Anything else?
exercises.hint: Agradeça e peça mais alguma coisa, se quiser.
answers: Thank you! Could I also get some extra towels?
Thanks, that's all for now.
exercises.explanation: *Could I also get...?* para pedidos extras.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: poderia mandar alguém consertar isso?
answers: Could you send someone to fix it?
